thread:
Maya: hey folks — just doing first-week checklist. I see an org invite pending but after I click Accept it redirects to SSO and then shows 'Access denied'. I can view some public repos but not the private ones I was told I'd need. who should I ping to get team membership sorted?

Linda (People Ops): @Maya can you check your email for the GitHub invite first? sometimes the invite link and the SSO link are separate steps. Also make sure you accepted the company SSO when prompted.

Maya: I found the email and clicked Accept. It takes me to the org page and then to our SAML page where it says I need 2FA enabled. I thought I already set it up though.

Jeff (EngAdmin): Hi @Maya — yep we enforce SSO + 2FA for org membership. Steps: 1) enable 2FA at https://github.com/settings/security 2) sign in to GitHub via "Sign in with SAML" from https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference. If you hit errors paste the exact message here and I can reissue invites.

Maya: quick Q — how do I confirm 2FA is active from the CLI?

Jeff (EngAdmin): You can't enable 2FA from CLI, but once enabled run a quick auth check:```bash
ssh -T git@github.com
```
It should respond like: "Hi Maya! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access." if keys/2FA/SAML are OK.

Maya: enabled 2FA, accepted SSO, ran the ssh check and got the expected message, but I still don't see access to private repo infra-config.

it-ops-bot: [system] Received request: add member 'Maya' -> team 'infra-readers'. Ticket #42. Provisioning queued.

Jeff (EngAdmin): I just queued the team add from the admin console and resent a team invite. Give it 2-3 minutes. If you're still blocked run:
```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra-config.git
```
and paste any errors here.

Maya: cloning worked! Repo cloned to my laptop. Thanks.

Maya: follow-up — is infra-readers read-only by default or do I have write rights?

Jeff (EngAdmin): infra-readers is read-only. If you need write access request it in the repo's OWNERS file or ping the repo owners (I'll link them if/when you need). We add people to infra-writers on a case-by-case basis.

Sam: welcome to the team @Maya :wave: happy to help with onboarding questions.

Maya: thanks everyone, everything's green now :tada:
